method: Static content coverage and editorial bias smoke test; not a verification of market significance or financial facts
manual_release_gates: Case selection documented BEFORE examples are drawn: systemic relevance, architectural variation, corridor relevance, current change, verifiable evidence.
Editor tests at least one comparable alternative for every home-page case (counterfactual substitution).
Currencies and account jurisdiction are represented separately; USD outside the US is not assumed to settle at the Fed.
Origin and destination direction matter; scheme reach is not conflated with settlement or payout reach.
Operations, rules, governance, ownership, access, clearing and finality have distinct actor labels.
Bank, non-bank, merchant, wallet, and cash recipient are all represented in archetype coverage.
A brand is not automatically the licensed entity; roles are product/market scoped.
No inference from not being named in public participant lists to non-participation.
No undocumented company-company edge; schematics label illustrative paths visibly.
Direct connection, direct clearing, direct settlement, eligible, and approved-but-not-live differ.
Competing proof is reviewed, including operator sources that may disagree with vendor marketing.
Publication date (if known) distinguished from review date, and older than 12 months flagged.
Logo size, positioning and diagram paths do not imply market size or prominence.
User-visible empty or unverified coverage is labelled instead of silently omitted.
measurement_notes: Counts measure editorial exposure only, not economic importance, and they are biased by how many times labels appear in headings and body copy.
A citation link on a page does not verify every claim.
The 19-currency list comes from the original research scope; country and currency are not interchangeable.
